# Pillar FAC02: Profitability loading (common factor set)
Definition: RMW beta from the same common-set point-in-time regression, shrunk by min(1, |t| / 2), scored as the loading minus VWRA's on the same set. Weight 0.30 of FAC.
Source: Ken French Developed 5 factors and momentum (verified); yfinance (verified). Better when: higher. Informs: portfolio_mix.
